info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Utility Billing Autopays-v3-spec
info.description: The Utility Billing Autopay Listing API enables users to retrieve a comprehensive list of automated payment setups for utility billing. This endpoint serves as a crucial resource for businesses looking to manage and track autopay arrangements effectively. Financial teams and billing system integrators can utilize this API to access details such as customer accounts and payment schedules, enhancing customer service and operational efficiency. It's designed for organizations aiming to streamline their billing processes and improve payment timeliness in the utility sector.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve the current autopay settings related to your billing account. It provides detailed information about whether autopay is enabled, the payment method, and the billing cycle associated with the autopay service.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving autopay billing settings. This body may include various options to specify how the retrieved information should be formatted or filtered.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the autopay details.

ListUtilityBillingAutopaysRequest.description: A JSON string representing the request body for the billing autopay operations.

status.description: Indicates whether the autopay operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number for the transaction.

resultId.description: An identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: The current state of the autopay operation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the request in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing any additional information about the autopay operation.

ListUtilityBillingAutopaysResponse_200.description: Response schema for the GET request to the autopay operations endpoint.

createdBy.description: The username or identifier of the individual or system that created the record.

createdAt.description: The timestamp indicating when the record was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the operation was performed automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Audit information related to the autopay operation.

x-processing-time.description: The amount of time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request.
